Join us on an unforgettable one-day tour of Marble Mountain and Lady Buddha Pagoda in Da Nang! Marvel at the stunning Marble Mountains, a cluster of five limestone peaks that offer breathtaking panoramic views and ancient caves to explore. As you wander through these majestic hills, discover hidden temples and serene grottoes carved into the rock. Next, we'll visit the iconic Lady Buddha Pagoda, home to the tallest statue of the Buddha in Vietnam. Standing at 67 meters, this impressive figure overlooks the coast and provides a tranquil retreat for reflection. Enjoy the beautiful gardens, intricate architecture, and sweeping ocean views. Today in this video we are going to take you to one day tour to Son Tra Mountain and Marble Mountain in Da Nang city of Vietnam. This tour blends natural beauty with spiritual serenity, making it a must-see for anyone visiting Da Nang. Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more travel adventures!
